questions.question: How should this combined command be surfaced in the CLI?

options.label: dockd instance up
options.description: New leaf under the existing `instance` group. Reads as 'bring this instance up'. e.g. `dockd instance up --package web --source github.com/me/pkgs`
options.preview:
dockd instance up \
  --package web \
  --source github.com/me/pkgs \
  [--name web] [--detached]

options.label: dockd up (top-level)
options.description: Top-level shortcut, docker-compose style. Fewer keystrokes, but sits outside the instance/package grouping.

options.label: Flag on `instance run`
options.description: Add `--ensure`/idempotent behavior to the existing `instance run` rather than a new command.

questions.question: If a container with that instance name already exists, what should the command do?

options.label: Reuse + ensure started
options.description: Existing container is kept as-is and just started if stopped (never recreated). True idempotent 'up'. Safest.
options.preview:
exists + stopped -> start
exists + running -> no-op
missing        -> provision

options.label: Recreate if spec changed
options.description: Compare against the package spec; destroy & re-provision if it drifted, else start. More 'declarative', more complex.
options.preview:
drifted -> destroy + provision
same    -> start
missing -> provision

options.label: Error on conflict
options.description: Only provision when absent; if a container with the name exists, fail and tell the user to use start/destroy.

options.label: Only if not present
options.description: Install from --source only when the named package isn't already in the packages root. Matches 'if not already installed'.
options.preview:
pkg present -> skip install
pkg absent  -> install_from_git

options.label: Always refresh
options.description: Always re-clone and reinstall from --source (overwrites), then run. Keeps package up to date each invocation.

options.label: --source optional
options.description: If --source given, install-if-missing; if omitted, require the package already be installed.
options.preview:
source + absent -> install
source + present-> skip
no source+absent-> error
